scope: Same-upload AAC140 versus frozen Opus251 tail comparison, no model changes.
conclusion: Distinct abrupt final partial losses persist at matching times in AAC and Opus, arguing against an Opus251-specific or PCM16-export cause. Chip versus shared upstream master processing remains unresolved.
ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 8.1.1 Copyright (c) 2000-2026 the FFmpeg developers

protocol.acquisition: Ordinary public yt-dlp format140 acquisition; no cookies, account, auth, signature workaround or external source master.
protocol.comparison: New AAC140(44.1kHz) and previously retained Opus251(48kHz), both decoded float48k stereo without level normalization. Existing PCM16 reference retained unchanged.
protocol.alignment: Find one constant integer lag from arithmetic stereo mid over Opus time2..30s, normalized correlation restricted±100ms. Decode resampling metadata retained. Test this frozen lag on60..80 and140..160s without new fitting. Do not fit affine scale or tail-specific lag.
protocol.source_frame_convention: Final benchmark noteoff182.178979166667s, frame8744591 at48kHz. Existing continuous affine audit noteoff182.178989328624s differs10.2microseconds; comparison times here reference same frozen benchmark event.
protocol.tail: Final Sine99 partials75,79,87. Frequency-selective observations from180.9..185s after global alignment. Nominal frequencies440*2^((MIDI-69)/12); fixed Hann tone demodulation24/48/96ms. Joint local sinusoidal LS across all four final MIDI39/75/79/87 andDC/linear trend in40ms windows with5ms hops, to separate partials. No model audio or envelope parameters used.
protocol.level: Report absolute per-channel and arithmetic-mid amplitude dBFS, plus each partial relative to its own held plateau overoff[-.2,-.1]s. No gain normalization or EQ is applied to audio.
protocol.endpoints: For fixed50/40/30dB relative levels, find final downward crossing afteroff+0.3s that remains below for100ms. If plateau, contamination or floor prevents a crossing, report absent. Also report peakheld-to-floortail levels, narrowband vs broad RMS and per-format curves. A lossy encoder may change floor, smear or delete partials; cross-format agreement does not prove silicon because master and prior processing shared.
known_limitations: Both formats are YouTube reencodes of one upload, not independent hardware captures or the source master.
AAC native44.1kHz requires resampling; integer global lag does not remove arbitrary frequency/phase differences.
Tail behavior can be from instrument, recording effects, master edit/gate or codec.
No exact gate delivery timestamps are known.

forensic_method_clarification.status: Frozen before codec-tail measurement; source-only forensic method clarification after the separate early-context lag freeze
forensic_method_clarification.basis: Joint fixed-frequency sine/cosine at MIDI39,46,58,59,67,75,79,87, plusDC and linear trend; Hann applied to both signal and basis, hence squared-Hann least-squares objective.40ms windows,2ms hops, left/right/mid. This reproduces the forensic investigator's declared basis, independently implemented.
forensic_method_clarification.alignment: Reuse exact627-frame AAC lag from alignment-frozen.json, no tail-specific lag or affine correction.
forensic_method_clarification.retained_primary: Original protocol's nominal-tone24/48/96ms Hann demodulation remains a separate analysis; do not conflate its support/thresholds with the joint-LS measurements.
forensic_method_clarification.endpoint: Use fixed -30,-40,-50dB relative held median off[-.2,-.1]s, final downward crossing afteroff+.3s and100ms sustained below. Also inspect absolute curves throughoff+3s. No endpoint optimization or model inference from format equality.
limitations: Partial87 can contain a harmonic of75; partial75 is also an8th harmonic of39. Frequency-specific survival is not per-voice identity.
Both formats share one unknown upload master; agreement cannot exclude original gate/edit/processing or codec decisions common to both.

format_alignment.method: One integer lag fitted on2..30s only; positiveAAC later. Unchanged validation on60..80 and140..160s.

limitations: Two reencodes of one unknown upload master, not independent hardware captures.
Codec/reference equality cannot locate an observed cutoff in the silicon.
Fixed-frequency components are not guaranteed separate voice identities.
Floors may be codec/capture noise, quantization, leakage or shared master artifacts.

normalized_lag_validation.initial_implementation_deviation: Original lag selection used unnormalized finite-window correlation despite protocol phrase normalized correlation; reported validation coefficients are normalized Pearson correlation.

posthoc_strict_check.type: Posthoc persistence validation; does not change frozen protocol or measured results
posthoc_strict_check.original_criterion: At least96% of50 subsequent samples below threshold (2ms hops; nominal100ms), permitting up to2 samples at/above threshold.
posthoc_strict_check.strict_criterion: All50 same subsequent samples below threshold. Same crossings, held-level definition, interpolation and final-crossing selection.
